content:
library(shiny)
library(dygraphs)
library(xts) # for time series data handlinga
library(dplyr)
library(shinyjs)
library(bslib)
library(shinyBS)
library(htmlwidgets)
# Create some example data
time_index <- seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"), length.out = 100, by = "day")
lower_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 2
upper_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 3
middle_line <- (lower_line + upper_line) / 2

# Combine into an xts object
data_for_dygraph <- xts(cbind(lower_line, upper_line, middle_line), order.by = time_index)
colnames(data_for_dygraph) <- c("lower", "upper", "middle")

divs = function(w,ml,mb,mt,bg,h) { paste0("display: inline-block;vertical-align:bottom; width:",w,";margin-left:", ml,"; margin-bottom:", mb,";margin-top:", mt,
                                          ";background-color:",bg,";height:",h,";") }
sheetname = "1fbxi0gsUxb9lJgli9LJL8PNKSwWiMvHx8UfjvMNzuuQ"
sheetname2 = "StockData"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
place <-  read.csv(url)
place$Date = as.Date(place$Date)
place <<- place

sheetname = "1riSYdnvql9O5OkVBlVEAw1ic3_gG0iRDxePvXP0KCyw"
sheetname2 = "ocean"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
ocean <<-  read.csv(url)


ui <- fluidPage(
  useShinyjs(),
  titlePanel("Stock Data with Crosshair (dygraphs)"),
  hidden(
    div(style=divs("50px","1px","0px","-0px","", ""),bsButton("hidden1","",icon("refresh"))%>%
          tooltip("hidden1"))),
  h3("update1-1"),

    fluidRow(
      column(6,
      selectInput("ticker", "Select Stock Ticker:", choices = unique(place$Symbol), selected = "AAPL"),
      dateRangeInput("dates", "Date Range:", start = Sys.Date() - 365, end = Sys.Date())
    ),
    column(6,
           selectInput("ticker1", "Select Stock Ticker:", choices = unique(place$Symbol), selected = "AAPL"),
           dateRangeInput("dates1", "Date Range:", start = Sys.Date() - 365, end = Sys.Date())
    )
    
    ),
   fluidRow(
     column(6,
      dygraphOutput("stock_graph"),
      dygraphOutput("myDygraph")
    ),
  column(6,
         dygraphOutput("stock_graph1"),
         dygraphOutput("myDygraph1")
  ))
  
  )


server <- function(input, output,session) {
  output$stock_graph <- renderDygraph({
    # Get stock data
 
    
    # Use only the Adjusted Close price for simplicity
    stock_data = place %>% filter(grepl("2",num) & Symbol %in% input$ticker )
    print(stock_data)
    stock_data<- stock_data %>% select(Date,Price)
    
    # Create the dygraph plot and add the crosshair plugin
    dygraph(stock_data) %>%
      dyOptions(axisLineColor = "white", gridLineColor = "white", colors = "lightblue") %>%
      dyCrosshair(direction = "both") %>% # Add crosshair in both directions
      dyRangeSelector() # Optional: add a range selector for easy zooming
  })
  
  output$myDygraph <- renderDygraph({
    # Create some example data (as above)
    time_index <- seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"), length.out = 100, by = "day")
    lower_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 2
    upper_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 3
    middle_line <- (lower_line + upper_line) / 2
    
    data_for_dygraph <- xts(cbind(lower_line, upper_line, middle_line), order.by = time_index)
    colnames(data_for_dygraph) <- c("lower", "upper", "middle")
    
    dygraph(data_for_dygraph) %>%
      dySeries("middle", label = "Middle Line") %>%
      dySeries(c("lower", "middle", "upper"), label = "Shaded Area", color = "blue", fillGraph = TRUE) %>%
      dyLegend(show = "always")
  })
  
  output$stock_graph1 <- renderDygraph({
    # Get stock data
    
    
    # Use only the Adjusted Close price for simplicity
    stock_data = place %>% filter(grepl("2",num) & Symbol %in% input$ticker1 )
    print(stock_data)
    stock_data<- stock_data %>% select(Date,Price)
    
    # Create the dygraph plot and add the crosshair plugin
    dygraph(stock_data) %>%
      dyOptions(axisLineColor = "white", gridLineColor = "white", colors = "lightblue") %>%
      dyCrosshair(direction = "both") %>% # Add crosshair in both directions
      dyRangeSelector() # Optional: add a range selector for easy zooming
  })
  
  output$myDygraph1 <- renderDygraph({
    # Create some example data (as above)
    time_index <- seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"), length.out = 100, by = "day")
    lower_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 2
    upper_line <- sin(seq(0, 10, length.out = 100)) + 3
    middle_line <- (lower_line + upper_line) / 2
    
    data_for_dygraph <- xts(cbind(lower_line, upper_line, middle_line), order.by = time_index)
    colnames(data_for_dygraph) <- c("lower", "upper", "middle")
    
    dygraph(data_for_dygraph) %>%
      dySeries("middle", label = "Middle Line") %>%
      dySeries(c("lower", "middle", "upper"), label = "Shaded Area", color = "blue", fillGraph = TRUE) %>%
      dyLegend(show = "always")
  })
  observeEvent(session,
               click("hidden1")
  )
  observeEvent(input$hidden1,{
    
    updateSelectInput(inputId = "ticker",
                        selected =  ocean$Symbol[2])           
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
